title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1970-02-02
lineage: SBD > MR > R > R > PCM > DAT > CDR > EAC (secure) > Cool Edit (minor fixes) > CD Wave (retracking) > shntool > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a stellar St. Louis show highlighted by an epic Dark Star (with a brief edit on Mason’s Children).
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this tape as one of the best 1970 Dark Star performances, calling it “truly stellar” and “beautiful.” The soundboard source is generally clear and high‑fidelity, though several reviewers note an audible cut during Mason’s Children that detracts slightly from an otherwise excellent recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently glowing comments about the performance (especially Dark Star) and a high‑quality soundboard source, with only minor editing issues noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, high‑fidelity copy praised as “high quality,” but an audible edit/cut in Mason's Children is mentioned as a drawback.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show revolves around an extended, fiery Dark Star; the overall pacing and energy are praised despite the brief edit on Mason's Children.

band_member_comments.Keys: Reference to a Pigpen tribute during Lovelight in the liner notes.
